title: Isometric party CRPG in Godot: it's all about the small details
author: OathAnvilDev
selftext:
Hey, Rafael here (solo dev at Oathanvil Entertainment). I'm building The Preserver's War on nights and weekends: an isometric party CRPG in Godot that uses Pathfinder 2e-inspired rules throughout, from combat to dialogue skill checks. I've been at it since July and Act 1 is free on itch. I used AI across code, art and sound (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, ElevenLabs).

With AI I had a rough version running pretty quickly. Most of my hours since then have gone into the small stuff like combat feel, style drift between assets, empty scenes, UI that works but feels wrong, and so on and on. It's one tiny fix after another! And that part of the craft and direction is what I care about most.

Anyway, here it is - free Act 1: [https://oathanvil.itch.io/the-preservers-war](https://oathanvil.itch.io/the-preservers-war)

I'd really love feedback on the game so I can keep improving it. I'm planning to keep building it until it is fully ready. And if you're deep in polish mode too, I'd like to hear what's worked for you! Lets swap notes
